bio_view.description: Display only; never approves or submits science. commandJson is {operationId: UUID, expected: latest bio_observe binding, kind, payload}. Kinds/payloads: openSource {source: SourceRef from bio_artifacts.sourceRef or bio_inputs}; setRepresentation {representation: cartoon|sticks|spheres|lines, appearance?: {colorScheme: auto|element|chain|residue|rainbow|uniform, uniformColor: integer RGB 0..16777215, material: matte|glossy|metal}}; select {sourceAtomIndices: unique <=512 original atom indices}; seekTime {timePs}; play {startFrame,endFrame,fps:1..20,direction:1|-1,loop:boolean}; focus/pause/observe {}. play range is zero-based PREVIEW positions 0..previewFrameCount-1; sourceFrameIndex can differ. Empty live viewport observation includes its binding with ok=false; openSource waits for real loading.

bio_observe.description: Read actual molecular renderer state. viewportId active selects the sole connected viewport; multiple viewers need an explicit ID. Offline or not-ready is an error.
